classification_basis.the_9_removed_lines_are_relocated_not_lo: 8 of 9 are the same guard statements relocated into the new outcome-based receipt constructor; verified by exact string presence in both versions
classification_basis.the_one_substantive_difference_is_a_gene: control enforces 'set(recompilation_pairs) == affected_keys', forcing EVERY affected dependent to carry a recompilation pair. The accepted version replaces this with a strictly stronger outcome-based invariant: every affected dependent requires exactly one OUTCOME (line ~776 'every affected dependent requires exactly one outcome'), an affected dependent may not receive both a replacement and a noncurrent disposition, and an outcome naming a dependent outside the affected set is refused. Exact coverage of the affected set is therefore still enforced, and the disjointness guard is preserved (line ~787).
classification_basis.why_this_is_not_an_owner_collision: the accepted version is a functional SUPERSET of the control version. Control is a strictly weaker earlier state of the SAME owner, not a competing owner. There is no semantic conflict to adjudicate, so the STOP condition was not triggered.
